source.snippet: Developers working with LLMs in a professional environment, is Spec Driven Development really the way forward with LLM coding agents? Over the past few months I've really tried to lean into SDD, after trying SpecKit and GSD, I finally settled on OpenSpec as my preferred spec generator. However I'm not quite ready to give up on understanding the actual code that the LLM is producing. To help with maintaining my comprehension of the generated code, I've tried a few different methods... (3 points, 3 comments, June 2026)

problem_statement: Professional developers using LLM coding agents struggle to maintain comprehension of AI-generated code when working in Spec Driven Development workflows. They are cycling through multiple paid tools (SpecKit, GSD, OpenSpec) seeking a solution that balances AI productivity with code understanding.
target_segment: Professional software developers and engineering teams using LLM-assisted coding agents in production workflows
notes: Buyer signal: poster mentions having already paid for and tried multiple competing tools (SpecKit, GSD, OpenSpec), indicating willingness to pay. Business context: explicitly frames as professional environment usage. Pain is recurring workflow friction, not a one-off issue. 3 points and 3 comments on HN suggests modest but real resonance. Opportunity: a tool or layer that surfaces intent/rationale alongside LLM-generated code to preserve developer comprehension without slowing AI productivity.
